summary: Engineers and NPCIL CMD Bhuwan Chandra Pathak manually load fuel bundles into the reactor face during initial fuel loading activities for Kakrapar Unit 4 (KAPP-4).

spans.shows: Engineers and officials wearing hard hats and yellow protective coats handling a nuclear fuel bundle and inserting it into a reactor face grid
spans.place_people: Bhuwan Chandra Pathak (CMD, NPCIL) at KAPP-4
spans.onscreen_text: Shri Bhuwan Chandra Pathak, CMD, NPCIL participates in Initial Fuel Loading activities of KAPP-4
